info.title: NX Hi-Fi
info.author: Anime0t4ku
info.description: Music player and remote for NX Hi-Fi and MiSTer Hi-Fi
info.details:
NX Hi-Fi is heavily based on my MiSTer Hi-Fi project, adapted for Nintendo Switch homebrew.

Play MP3, FLAC, PCM WAV and Ogg Vorbis from your SD card or SMB network shares, with album artwork, a five-band equalizer, shuffle, repeat and seeking. Includes handheld and docked layouts, touch and controller controls, themes and a visualizer.

Use your Switch as a handheld remote for MiSTer Hi-Fi: browse sources, select music and manage playback and settings while audio plays on your MiSTer. You can also control another NX Hi-Fi device using Independent control or Screen control. Connect devices on the same network with the target Web Remote enabled.

A browser-based Web Remote is also available for controlling this Switch. Full-memory application mode (title override) is recommended. This is a foreground music player, not a background sysmodule.

changelog: First public release. Local and SMB music playback, artwork, equalizer, themes, Web Remote, NX Hi-Fi remote modes and MiSTer Hi-Fi remote control.
